caption: The drawing depicts two detached shirt collars positioned one above the other on a plain light beige background. Each collar is made of a stiff, light tan material with darker and lighter patches suggesting shading and dimension. Both collars have pointed edges and are fastened at the front by a thin, off-white ribbon tied into a bow. The stitching and buttonholes are indicated with detailed lines in a slightly darker shade than the collars themselves. There are no additional objects or background elements; the focus remains solely on the two collars and their construction details.
title: Man's Linen Collar
